Table.name: 03_MEDIA
Table.comment:
Quotation valuation data (see Tab Page 03_MEDIA) Objective: To promote offers in all multi-channel publications (web, print, application, ERP, ...). - Includes URL links and/or names of data such as: product and/or range sales leaflet, product sheets, instructions, photos, video, Certificate of Conformity Mark (CMC), Product Environmental Profile (PEP), Keywords...
Données de valorisation des offres (cf. Onglet 03_MEDIA) Objectif : Valoriser les offres dans toutes les publications multi-canal (web, print, applicatif, ERP, ...) - Comprend les Liens URL et/ou noms des données de type : argumentaire produit et/ou gamme, fiches produits, notice, photos, vidéo, Certificat Marque de Conformité (CMC), Profil Environnemental Produit (PEP), Mots clés...

Column.name: MARQUE
Column.comment: Name of the marketing brand of the reference. Is equal, by default, to MANUFACTURER

Column.name: TYPM
Column.comment: Media data types: 17 codes Description and codes to be entered in the "media table" tab: - Argument of the reference (ARGU) - Range of products (ARGUG) - Certificate of Conformity Mark (CMC) - Environmental and Health Declaration Form (FDES) - Product sheet (SHEET) - Keywords (MCLES) - Notice (NOTICE) - Product Environmental Profile (PEP) - 360° photo (PHOTO360) - 3 dimensional photo (PHOTO3D) - Low definition photo (PHOTOBD) - High definition photo (PHOTOHD) - High definition photo of the product in the atmosphere (PHOTOHDA) - Pictograms (PICTO) - Diagram (SCHEMA) - Slogan or promotional catchphrase (SLOGAN) - Video (VIDEO) Each media is described in the tab "Media table".

Column.name: NUM
Column.comment: Sequence number of values for the same characteristic Integer Field filled in systematically, default value = 1 Example: if the Manufacturer provides 2 photos, the main photo will have order number 1, the next one will have order number 2.

Column.name: CODVAL
Column.comment: This field is used by the media data types "ARGU", "ARGUG", "CMC", "MCLES" and "SLOGAN". Personalized description by media, in the "Media table". Number of free characters.

Column.name: NOM
Column.comment: Name of the document or photo, with its suffix (.pdf or .jpg or .eps or ...) 3 possibilities to make the document or photo available : - in DOCUMENT (see the description of this data block on the first page of the notice - via the download link in the URLT field) - via the URL link for direct display on the merchant site Number of free characters.

Column.name: URL
Column.comment: URL: link for displaying the media without storage by the Distributor. For example: * link of a PHOTOBD for direct embedding on a merchant site * link with direct display of the pdf of the SHEET or NOTICE or CMC or FDES or PEP * link to the manufacturer's site for dynamic display of the product sheet * link to Youtube for direct display of the video Recommended number of characters of the link: less than 2,000

Column.name: URLT
Column.comment: URLT: link to download the media for integration into the Distributor's Product Information Management (PIM) system. Examples : * direct download link of the document containing the argument * direct download link for a high definition photo * link to download pdf of SHEET or NOTICE or CMC or FDES or PEP Recommended number of characters of the link: less than 2 000
